azimuth.doc: Direction of the plane's normal around the vertical axis, from +X
azimuth.label: Azimuth

elevation.doc: Tilt of the plane's normal above the horizontal; 90 points straight up, so the plane is horizontal
elevation.label: Elevation

offset.doc: Distance of the plane from the centre of the mesh's bounding box, along its normal, in object units
offset.label: Offset

keep.doc: Which side stays: above is the side the normal points to
keep.label: Keep

run.doc: Cut the mesh in place and keep one side; leaves it untouched when nothing would remain

report.doc: One line describing the last cut
